title: Managed Backup: availability bands
content:
For Managed Backup, the following tier basis defines availability bands.

## Tier basis

**Availability target percentage.** Monthly availability percentage above which no outage credit is due; decimal.

**Descending availability credit bands.** Descending lower-inclusive availability thresholds and credit fractions below the SLA target; mapping list.

| Contract tier | Availability target percentage | Descending availability credit bands |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 5 TB | 99.9 | Minimum: 99; Fraction: 0.1; Minimum: 95; Fraction: 0.2; Minimum: 0; Fraction: 0.3 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 10 TB | 99.9 | Minimum: 99; Fraction: 0.1; Minimum: 95; Fraction: 0.2; Minimum: 0; Fraction: 0.3 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 25 TB | 99.9 | Minimum: 99; Fraction: 0.1; Minimum: 95; Fraction: 0.2; Minimum: 0; Fraction: 0.3 |

## Tier lookup

For the Northbridge Managed Backup 5 TB tier, availability target percentage is 99.9.

## Hypothetical comparison

In a hypothetical switch between any of the listed tiers, availability target percentage stays the same.
